description: This PHP source file defines a function 'display_field_lines' that generates HTML and JavaScript for displaying and managing form field lines in the SuiteCRM framework, particularly within the 'AOR_Fields' module. The function handles language file loading, dynamically includes JavaScript files, manages interaction elements such as buttons, and loads existing field data for editing views.

methods.name: display_field_lines
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript code for displaying and interacting with field lines in the SuiteCRM 'AOR_Fields' module, supporting both read-only and edit operations with dynamic content loading.
